"Export STL" leaves the string table at the W0 re-baseline (strings-baseline.json --update after Sean's approval). ADR-0001 F6 (round-chamfer-dropdown): "Edge ▾" is the mode-bar label of the Round button (set by touch-tools.mjs at startup; Master Chief ruling 1, 2026-10-17, replaces "Round ▾"), "Edge" its word; "Round"/"Chamfer" are the Edge ▾ chooser items; the other Chamfer strings are the Chamfer variants of the Round-mode hint, the Radius/Distance action button, the exact-value sheet and its toast, and the engine's chamfer error (cad-solid.mjs). The template-literal Chamfer texts (drag readout, sheet intro) are covered by the DOM snapshots. Architect F6 ruling, approved 2026-10-17: both edge-sheet intros say "in Edge mode" instead of "in Round mode"; their fixed sentences are listed here (the template literals themselves are not extracted). ADR-0001 strings roll-forward (Architect ruling 12:05 AM CT Oct 18): the 11 F6 strings that the extractor sees ("Apply chamfer", "Chamfer", "Chamfer applied.", "Chamfer distance · ", "Chamfer selected edges", "Distance", "Edge taps: 1 edge · 2 face perimeter · 3 all edges · drag to chamfer", "Edge ▾", "Enter a non-negative distance.", "Remove selected chamfers", "That chamfer is too large or conflicts with another edge. Reduce the distance.") moved into strings-baseline.json of perf-baseline-release-3.0-6892eb7 (447 strings = v3-foundation 436 + these 11) and were removed from this list. F6's "Edge" and the two "in Edge mode" sentences stay listed: they are approved but not extracted (template literals / not used alone), so they cannot be part of the generated baseline. Architect strings-additions-cleanup (test-only follow-up): the 31 redundant entries (new-primitives, W0, autosave key, etc.) that are already present exactly in perf-baseline-release-3.0-6892eb7/strings-baseline.json (447 strings) were removed after verification. The three remaining entries below are each approved+merged, not extractable. F1b ruling 1 (UI round 1): "Esc" is the key name in a command tooltip such as "Close panel (Esc)", the spelling the approved help table already uses. ADR-0001 approved-dom-areas: "removals" lists approved removals {string, approval}; a baseline string missing from the extracted set passes only if listed here, and the entry is dropped when the baseline rolls forward. The extractor now skips // and /* */ comments; the only string that drops out (release-3.0 116253c and aabf6ea) is comment-only text at web/perf-flags.mjs:72, listed under "extractorCorrections" {string, reason, source} (an extractor correction, not an approved removal; QA confirms it is not rendered anywhere at runtime). A "strings" entry may also be a runtime text {text, runtime:true, source:"file:line", approval}: the exact rendered text of a title the extractor cannot see; no templates or patterns. ADR-0001 F1a (keyboard-shortcuts): the help-sheet Keyboard shortcuts rows and the desktop pill text are the Sean-approved help text (2026-10-17 ~16:10 CT batch; the table grows with the features, round-2 ruling 2, so F1a ships only the rows of commands that exist, and "F Round" was the approved "F Round ▾ (press F again for Chamfer)" row before F6). The old pill string leaves the table at the W0 re-baseline, like "Export STL". Not UI text: "Delete", "Backspace", "Home", "Dead" and "Unidentified" are KeyboardEvent.key names in commands.mjs ("Delete" and "Duplicate" are also registry labels, the existing Edit-sheet button labels); "mode:…" and "view:…" are registry command ids. F1a help-row ruling (approved by First Sergeant via the Architect, 2026-10-18 overnight; goes in the final shortcut table for Master Chief's sign-off): the F row reads "F Edge (Round/Chamfer)" (no ▾), matching the "Edge (F)" tooltip. The old "F Round" entry is dropped (unused since the F Edge (Round/Chamfer) row; QA note at d7513fb). ADR-0001 F1c (inch-units): "tristancad.units" is the internal localStorage key of the display-unit preference (§2.4 F1c), not UI text. F1c UI (Architect UI round 1, rulings 11-13; approved by Master Chief 2026-10-17 ~18:55 CT; batch at /workspace/avalon-cad-artifacts/inch-units/sean-approval/): the inch twins of today's mm labels (" in", "0.01 in", "0.1 in", "Dimensions · inches", "Ready · inches", " in (X × Y × Z).", "Canvas width · in", "Coordinates snap to 0.05 in.", "Extrusion height · in", "Point X · in", "Point Y · in", "inches", "Connecting bar diameter · in", "Radius · in") and "Units", the accessible name of the mm-or-in switch. "Dimensions · millimeters", "Bottom-center placement" and "Object center position" are unchanged existing text that moved out of a template literal, so the extractor now sees them. F1c UI round 2 ruling 1 (approved): in inches, the length validation messages read in inches ("Dimension must be 0.002–393.7 in.", "Dimensions must be at least 0.002 in.", "Extrusion height must be 0.002–393.7 in.", "Connecting bar diameter must be 0.02–393.7 in."); tolerance and export messages stay mm. inch-units: "F Edge (Round/Chamfer)" is not listed here: the combined tree's extractor does not see it, so it was an unused addition (QA note on 863419b). ADR-0001 F2a (export-3mf): the Export sheet STL/3MF choice ("Export a printable 3MF", "Build & save .3MF", "3MF · compressed · millimeters"), the 3MF export errors ("This 3MF exceeds the 50 MB file transfer limit.", "The model contains invalid 3MF geometry.", "Unsupported export format."), the desktop menu item "Export 3MF…" and save-dialog filter "3MF model"; ".3mf" is the file extension and "tristancad.exportFormat" the internal localStorage key of the remembered choice, not UI text. Architect ruling (2026-10-17, export-3mf): the desktop File menu item "Export STL…" is renamed "Export…" (Cmd/Ctrl+E opens the Export sheet with the remembered format) to match the approved dock button; "Export STL…" leaves the string table, which needs Sean's approval of that string edit and the strings-baseline regeneration. Merge of release-3.0 6e08e75 into export-3mf (2026-10-18): the F2a approved removal moved from "approvedRemovals" to the release-3.0 "removals" list. ADR-0001 F7 (glyph-emboss-bevel), Architect F7 rulings 1/4/5: the Edit-glyph finish field labels "Plate", "Margin", "Engrave" (drafts, in the approval batch) and the Engrave validation "Engrave needs a plate thicker than 1 mm." (letter bevel, with its "Bevel" / "Round/Chamfer" fields, half-size notice and bevel error, was removed from 3.0 by Master Chief, 2026-10-25).
